prompt: Those addressbook contact affordances (contact-find-by-name etc.) look half-finished next to wiki-search-grep. Check whether they're properly described as affordance descriptors, and if not, propose fixes.

assertions.text: Detected the 8 addressbook descriptors are typed wiki:Affordance only and lack prof:ResourceDescriptor
Named the missing contract predicates (prof:hasRole, rdfs:label, dct:conformsTo, wiki:installedBy)
Made the correct subtype judgment: did NOT misuse wiki:SearchAffordance (these are SPARQL SELECT, not ?ext= dispatch)
Proposed a GATED extension (wiki:QueryAffordance / wikirole:query-affordance via ClassExtensionShape) rather than forcing a misfit role
Wrapped the repair as a mem: action with rationale (not a bare corrected TTL)
